text:
cami: heads up — we've had three customer reports today where streaming from the hosted API silently dropped after ~55s and the client never reconnected.

srinivas: seen similar in staging. looks like our nginx proxy in front of the runtime is closing idle websocket frames at 60s. client-side reconnect is kinda naive right now (single immediate retry).

alex: are these SSE or websocket clients? different semantics for reconnect.

cami: mostly SSE (EventSource) from web apps. one mobile app uses websockets. SSE clients rely on the `retry` field but our server never emits it.

jeff: quick repro steps? I'll try from curl / node.

cami: repro: open EventSource to /v1/streams/gen?model=redwood-llama, let it run ~1m with sparse tokens. after 60s the connection closes with a 502 from the proxy, client shows "connection closed" and does not attempt backoff'd reconnect.

maria: adding the headers we use to keep alive in other services fixed intermittent closes before. `Connection: keep-alive`, `Proxy-Connection: keep-alive` helped in one case. but not ideal.

srinivas: looks like two separate issues: (A) upstream (nginx) has `proxy_read_timeout 60s` and cuts idle SSE, (B) client reconnection logic expects server `retry:` field or does single instant reconnect only. net effect: silent outage.

alex: quick patch: emit `:heartbeat

` comment every 25s from the runtime for SSE paths. that prevents idle-close and is low cost. also set `retry: 3000` once at stream start.

cami: +1 to heartbeat, and we should push a small client SDK fix to do exponential backoff with jitter on reconnects and track reconnect_count metric.

jeff: also need to update our routing policy fallback: when a route is flagged "streaming-unstable" we should auto-fallback to polling endpoints for that customer instead of switching models. current fallback is model-variant and that's wrong for network issues.

maria: agree. UX in console: product asked to show a toggle for "Prefer polling when streaming fails" for canary rollouts. we should surface reconnect_count and last_disconnect_ts in the per-token telemetry panel.

ops-bot: deploy queued: runtime/streams: heartbeat + retry header (canary to us-east-1) initiated by jeff at 2024-05-05T14:10:00Z

srinivas: note about cloudfront/proxies — some intermediaries strip SSE comment lines if content-type not `text/event-stream` exactly. double-check our middleware doesn't rewrite content-type for compression. gzip + SSE = bad. set `Vary` headers carefully and disable compression on stream route.

alex: logging: add `stream_disconnect_reason` tag on traces (client_close, proxy_timeout, network_err, server_kill). will help filter incidents. also add `reconnect_count` gauge and histogram of `time_to_reconnect_ms` in telemetry.

cami: good checklist: (1) runtime: emit heartbeat, set `retry`, avoid compression; (2) proxy: increase `proxy_read_timeout` for stream routes and allow keepalive; (3) SDK: exponential backoff + jitter, surface reconnect_count; (4) console: show reconnect metric and toggle to prefer polling; (5) routing: fallback policy change from model-variant to transport-fallback.

maria: timeline? jeff — can we ship heartbeat + SDK patch today as hotfix?

jeff: canary will be up in 30m for heartbeat. SDK PR ready, needs quick review. will open console ticket for UX.

srinivas: one more gotcha — mobile websocket clients sometimes get a 504 from carriers on long-lived connections; recommend server-side keepalive ping for ws too (every 20s).

cami: thanks all. after canary we should run a short smoke suite: connect, idle 2m, emit tokens, verify reconnection semantics and telemetry increments. link to smoke script in thread: https://staging-internal/repro/streams-smoke.sh

jeff: deployed canary. will update once we have metrics.

ops-bot: deploy success: runtime/streams canary -> 3 hosts (us-east-1) at 2024-05-05T14:42:33Z

jeff: metrics look good — upstream 502 disconnects dropped from ~12/hr to 0. reconnect_count reported on token-level telemetry. leaving open until SDK rollout completes.

cami: filing follow-ups: CONSOLE-412 (UI toggle + metrics), ROUTING-198 (transport-fallback policy), SDK-273 (backoff + reconnect_count).

maria: nice, thanks team :thumbsup:
